common.name: {name}
settlement.gap_explained: {name}, your settlement for {date_label} is short by {gap}: {breakdown}. No action is needed from you.
settlement.gap_explained_spoken: {name}, your settlement for {date_label} is short by {gap_spoken} rupees: {breakdown_spoken}. No action is needed.
settlement.unreconciled: {name}, your settlement for {date_label} is short by {gap}, and only {explained} of it matches known deductions. We have sent this to the settlements team (ticket {ticket_id}).
settlement.ok: {name}, your settlement for {date_label} arrived in full: {actual}.
settlement.none: We could not find a settlement record for your account yet.
device.low_battery: Your Soundbox battery is at {battery}%. Please connect the charger.
device.low_battery_spoken: Soundbox battery is at {battery_spoken} percent. Please connect the charger.
device.offline: Your Soundbox has not been seen for {minutes} minutes. Please switch it off and on again and check the network.
device.offline_spoken: Soundbox has been offline for {minutes_spoken} minutes. Please restart it and check the network.
device.ok: Your Soundbox is working fine. Battery is at {battery}%.
device.ok_spoken: Soundbox is working fine. Battery is at {battery_spoken} percent.
device.none: No Soundbox is linked to your account.
refunds.pending: Your refund of {amount} (bank ref {bank_ref}) is in process and should arrive by {expected_by}.
refunds.overdue: Your refund of {amount} (bank ref {bank_ref}) was due by {expected_by} and has not arrived. We have sent it to the banking team (ticket {ticket_id}).
refunds.demand_prefix: Saarthi cannot issue refunds itself; only an authorised person can. Here is your refund status:
payments.failed_summary: In the last {days} days, {count} payment(s) failed. Latest: {amount}, reason: {reason}.
payments.none: No payments failed in the last {days} days.
dispute.escalated: A chargeback dispute of {amount} is open (deadline {deadline}). This is a risky case, so a specialist will handle it (ticket {ticket_id}). You will not need to repeat your story.
dispute.playbook_evidence: For the {amount} chargeback: please upload the bill and delivery proof in the app before {deadline}. This is how similar cases were resolved before.
checkup.cached_note: (Checked {minutes_ago} minutes ago. Tap 're-check' to check again.)
checkup.cooldown_note: (Just checked. You can re-check in {wait_seconds} seconds.)
checkup.quota_exceeded: You have used today's check-ups. Please try again tomorrow, or raise an issue and a person will help.
escalation.generic: Your case has been sent to our specialist (ticket {ticket_id}). You will not need to repeat your story.
escalation.killswitch: Automatic actions are paused for safety right now. A person will handle your request (ticket {ticket_id}).
offer.proposal: Based on your collections, you are eligible for a working-capital loan of up to {max_amount}. Would you like to know more?
offer.declined_ack: Okay, noted. We will not suggest a loan again.
loan.emi_quote: For {amount} over {tenure} months, the EMI is {emi} per month at {rate}% a year. Say 'apply' to send an application; a person approves it.
loan.ask_amount: How much loan do you need?
loan.not_eligible: You are not eligible for a loan right now.
loan.applied: Your loan application for {amount} (id {request_id}) has been submitted. An officer will review it; Saarthi never approves loans itself.
loan.approve_refused: Only an authorised officer can approve a loan. Saarthi cannot do that.
payment.refused: For your safety, Saarthi never makes payments or confirms bookings. Please open 'Review and Pay' and enter your UPI PIN yourself.
security.credential: Warning: Paytm and Saarthi never ask for your UPI PIN, OTP or password. Do not share it with anyone. We have not processed this message.
security.injection: Sorry, I can only help with your account, payments, Soundbox, loans and travel.
clarify.care: Please tell me what you need help with: settlement, Soundbox, payment/refund, or loan?
degraded.human_queue: I could not understand this fully, so I have sent your question to a person (ticket {ticket_id}).
smalltalk.greeting: Namaste! I am Saarthi. I can check your settlement, Soundbox, payments and refunds, and help with flights.
travel.ask_destination: Where would you like to fly to?
travel.ask_origin: Which city are you flying from?
travel.ask_date: On which date do you want to travel?
travel.no_flights: No flight data found from {origin} to {destination} around {date}.
travel.date_adjusted: No flights on {requested}; showing options for {actual}.
travel.reason.cheapest_is_best: Recommended: {airline} at {price}. It is the cheapest and also scores best on time, stops and reliability.
travel.reason.costlier_faster: Recommended: {airline} at {price}. It costs {price_diff} more than the cheapest but arrives {minutes_saved} minutes sooner.
travel.reason.costlier_better_score: Recommended: {airline} at {price}. It costs {price_diff} more than the cheapest but scores better on stops and on-time record.
travel.handoff_notice: You will review and pay yourself using the 'Review and Pay' link. Saarthi never pays or confirms bookings.
travel.roadmap.search: Search flights for {date} and one day either side
travel.roadmap.score: Score every option on price, duration, timing, stops, refund policy and on-time record ('{preference}' weights)
travel.roadmap.handoff: Prepare CHEAPEST / FASTEST / BEST_BALANCE and a Review & Pay link for you
travel.status.on_time: Booking {booking_ref}: {airline} {flight_no} on {date} at {dep_time} is on time. Gate {gate}.
travel.status.delayed: Booking {booking_ref}: {airline} {flight_no} on {date} is delayed by {delay} minutes. Gate {gate}.
travel.status.cancelled: Booking {booking_ref}: {airline} {flight_no} on {date} is cancelled. Please open the booking to see options.
travel.status.not_found: I could not find that booking on your account.
pulse.text: Good morning {name}! Your settlement for {date_label} was {actual}{gap_part}. Pending refunds: {pending_refunds}. Open disputes: {open_disputes}. Soundbox battery: {battery}%.
pulse.no_settlement: Good morning {name}! No settlement record yet. Soundbox battery: {battery}%.
advice.festival: {festival} is {days} days away. Expect more customers: keep the Soundbox fully charged (now {battery}%) and keep change ready.
advice.no_festival: No major festival in the next {days} days.
advice.battery_low: Your Soundbox battery is {battery}%. Charge it before the evening rush.
advice.battery_ok: Your Soundbox battery is {battery}%, which is fine.
voice.not_understood: Sorry, I could not hear that clearly. Please say it again.
